description: Phase 2 redesign follows the completion of Phase 1, which identified that yard congestion is caused by poor block allocation rather than insufficient space and that roughly 20 % of effective capacity can be recovered through re‑zoning. The redesign will involve a two‑day session with the operations team in early May to implement these changes.

timeline.entry: After completing Phase 1, the team moved into Phase 2 redesign, with Felix requesting two days of the operations team in early May to continue the work.
In early May, Phase 2 redesign will commence, with Felix requesting two days of Yusuf’s operations team to work on it.
